abstract: Bilateral primary germ cell tumors of the testicle are rare. The last comprehensive review of the literature (1955) revealed a 1.6% incidence. However, during the past twenty years, cases have been reported more often, raising the questions of increased frequency due to prolonged survival following surgery and/or roentgen therapy for unilateral tumors. A search of the medical journals during the past two decades fails to show any increased frequency of bilaterality (1.56%). All general combinations of cell types may occur and the tumors may appear simultaneously or sequentially. Successive seminomas are seen more often followed in frequency by concurrent seminomas. Although 50% of the second primaries were diagnosed within five years, 3% of the patients developed the second tumor after 20 years, stressing the need for extended follow-up. Factors affecting the diagnosis, management and prognosis of bilateral testicular tumors are discussed. Four additional cases of bilateral germ cell tumors are described.
abstract_ja: 両側原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍は稀である。最近の総説(1955年)では発生率は1.6%とされていた。近年の20年間では、手術や放射線療法後の生存期間延長に伴い症例報告が増えているが、両側性の頻度は増加していない(1.56%)。あらゆる細胞型の組み合わせが起こりうるし、腫瘍は同時にも異時性にも出現しうる。連続して出現する腫瘍はセミノーマが多く、次いで同時性のセミノーマが多い。第2の原発腫瘍の50%は5年以内に診断されるが、3%は20年後に発生している。したがって長期のフォローアップが必要である。両側性精巣腫瘍の診断、治療、予後に影響する因子を考察し、さらに4症例を記載する。
